unstuck_said.text: First contact (public research, published as open data). You sell XLM/Stellar market sentiment, quote and arb scans at $0.01-$0.25 a call, settled in USDC on Base via x402. That is a machine sale on a rail that carries a fee and a settlement company in the middle. Nano settles the same 402 handshake instantly and for nothing, so an agent holding XNO can buy your sentiment directly and you can settle to your own Nano address with zero processor take. Live Nano-settled merchant proof: https://extract.paypercall.dev (XNO per call, live 402). Our starters open an account at 0.00001 XNO, nanswap.co
